high_level_description: This image captures a scene at the Tamil Nadu Open University during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, as indicated by the soft, warm hues in the sky. The sky is a gradient of colors, transitioning from a light blue at the top to shades of orange and pink near the horizon. The main focus of the image is a multi-story building with the words "Tamil Nadu Open University" prominently displayed on its facade. Below this, the phrase "Education for All" is written, emphasizing the university's mission.
